a: Chandra X-ray time from a reserve of up to 1 Ms per cycle; DDT observations are not eligible for funding
dt: Requests accepted at any time through the DDT proposal system
e: Chandra's channel for unique, time-critical X-ray opportunities (including unanticipated targets of opportunity) that cannot wait for the next annual cycle. Requests need a 1-3 page science justification and are judged by the CXC Director with the NASA Project Scientist.
unv: The page does not state who may be PI (no nationality limit is mentioned) or whether students may be PI.
